assumptions: Rectangular equal-length spans replace the drawing's shorter spans and overhangs.
Beds and both screen layers are repeated in every span; partial layouts and the central cross aisle are simplified.
Eave 4.2 m and ridge 5.0 m follow the provisional specification; drawing page 6 appears to dimension the eave at 5.0 m.
Screens retain their specified full width and heights even where they intersect the provisional roof; no automatic clipping.
Screens retract toward negative X by scaling; no folded fabric or roller mechanics.
Trusses and gutters are visual connecting members using visual_frame_radius, not fabrication sections.
Bed z is the bottom elevation; row centers divide each span into equal-width cells.
Bed width, height, elevation and end margins are unverified visual defaults from the specification, not measured dimensions.
Quadratic Bezier roof curvature and the circular visual frame section are visualization approximations, not reconstructed construction profiles.
Cherry tomato height, fruit count, foliage and visual spacing are approximate; plants are capped at 80 per bed.
Equipment existence is drawing-supported (pages 30-31); end-aisle placement is a provisional visualization arrangement, not a surveyed installation location.
Drive dimensions, rack travel, pinion/drum rotation and curtain routing are approximate visual relationships, not calibrated mechanics.
All environment sensor positions are unverified placeholders; no real PLC tags or live readings are assigned.

roof_vents.assumption: Representative visual panel; dimensions and placement are not verified from the drawing.

placement.note: Provisional end aisle preserves all 20 beds; not the exact equipment location on drawing pages 30-31. In end_service_strip mode X/Y are derived from the current footprint; x/y apply only in absolute mode.
